description.narrative:
Peace-promoting dialogue meetings and training of youth in peace dialogue:
- Media messaging enhancing peace, - and progress of a national platform enhancing youth participation for dialogue for peace.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative: - the NGO "Building Bridges" initiated and registered, with focus on peace dialogue. - a social media campaign mobilising youth for peace produced and disseminated. - documentaries and radio programmes with lessons for peace dialogue produced. - youth leaders from various regions/groups trained for peaceful leadership as planned by this project, and acting to enhance peace dialogue at regional and local levels. - youth dialogue meetings carried out at regional levels, to enhance peace, in Bahir Dar, Harar, Hawassa, Arba Minch).
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
